summary: Router for agentic systems that routes prompts to optimal AI models under 50ms, reducing costs by 40-70% with a simple endpoint change.
usecases: Cost optimization for LLM-heavy applications by dynamically routing prompts to cheaper models
Building agentic systems requiring fast, reliable model switching without latency
Providing an OpenAI-compatible API gateway for seamless integration with existing tools
ideas: Integrate caching layers to further reduce latency and costs
Support routing based on user tier or compliance requirements
Hybrid cloud/edge deployment with local LLMs
